The '''Praesitlyn theater''' was one of the six theaters of operations of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which took place during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Astrography==
The Praesitlyn theater was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> This field of operations was named after the key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Praesitlyn/Legends|Praesitlyn]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
In the Praesitlyn theater, [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] were deployed from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] to besiege worlds such as [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]] and [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]. As a result of this campaign, the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist leadership]] was evacuated from [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
